title: Design system probe respects CMS component capability and keeps negative controls
steps: Load the actual Apple and Moxie profiles and build role expectations with and without reference component adoption.
Score an Apple button retaining the measured EmDash capsule and a deliberately wrong page colour; compare the default adopting expectation and a Refero control.
expect: EmDash excludes only unadopted reference-derived values, retaining palette and stated-font expectations.
The same wrong button remains a mismatch for adopting CMSs; the wrong page colour fails for EmDash; Refero expectations remain unchanged.
fence: Tests the declared CMS capability boundary; does not change emitted styles or relax colour or geometry tolerances. The old function fails the new regression.
